name: Katou Yukari
source:
She switched from being a stage actress to a voice actress. In her younger days, she was a charismatic voice actress who boasted of her idol-like popularity.

However, when the president of her production company tried to have a sexual relationship with her, she refused, which led to resentment and the end of her career as a voice actress.

She then set up a private agency to nurture Maya Ichijou, who became a voice actress because she admired her when she was a popular voice actress.

Currently, she is working hard as a manager to promote Maya. She is intelligent and has a winning personality. She hates men due to past trauma. She is a virgin.
